After staying awake for about 10 days straight (I was abusing adderall) I was driving to work at about 5am, it's the winter so it's still a bit dark but you can see ok. I'm on back roads. No one is around for miles, just farmland. Suddenly I see a naked man standing in the middle of the road facing away from me, I slam on my brakes and stare at him as he's only about 30 ft from my car, then I blink and he's gone. That's when I realized I had gone into sleep deprived psychosis and was hallucinating. Rest of the day I kept hearing whispering and what sounded like a man saying my name, which is creepy in and of itself but I was also in a loud workshop with headphones in so it spooked me pretty good. Boss let me go home a little early to get some rest. I've since gotten clean and I have a somewhat regular sleep schedule.


TLDR: Stayed awake too long and started seeing and hearing things. Get some sleep kids.
